rationale: Option B (random hand-labeled sample plus rerunning with the published and paraphrased prompts) is the more complete reliability check. It covers both false positives and false negatives, and it tests prompt sensitivity directly. That suits a pragmatic evaluator who wants a feasible, calibrated approach. Option A audits only judge-positive responses, so it can't measure recall, and a second stricter rater adds cost with less coverage.
